page0.text:
...
I nod.
I apologized to Tohsaka, who stood beside and stared at me with downcast eyes, in my head and obeyed Caster's words.

page1.text:
"Ungh..."
Saber looks away at my choice, unable to make up her mind.

page2.text:
"..."
Tohsaka doesn't say a thing.
We promised to beat Caster together, yet she doesn't nag me and just bites her lip.

page3.text: "That is a smart decision, boy. Yes, that is what I expect from a Master chosen by the Holy Grail. You did not have a chance of winning against me from the start, so obeying me is the best option."

page4.text:
...Caster raises her arm.
The fingers that were grabbing Fuji-nee's neck go for my heart.

page5.text:
"...Hold on. Promise me one thing before I do as you wish."
"...Fine. You do not seem to know your position, but I shall listen. What would you like in return, boy?"

page6.text:
"...It's about Tohsaka. It sounds like you want to kill Tohsaka. Promise you won't lay a finger on her until she gets home."
"Shirou."

page7.text:
Caster doesn't answer.
The purple robe stares at me indifferently without moving, and...

page8.text:
"Heh... Heheh, muahahahahahahahahahaha!
I wondered what kind of sales pitch you were going to make, but you obeyed me for such a thing!? Haha, that's wonderful boy! I wonder how many years has it been since I've laughed this much!"

page9.text:
"...What's so funny, Caster?
It's a stupid condition all right, but you have no right to laugh at Shirou."

page10.text:
"Yes, you are right, young lady. You are the only one who can laugh at him. That is why there is value in accepting this condition."
"...All right. I was going to kill her here, but I shall make an exception and let her live. It is my ally's one wish. It is not fair if I do not grant it."

page11.text:
The mage snickers.
Glaring at her, Tohsaka slowly retreats.

page12.text:
...
"Goodbye. It was going to end up like this anyway. We'll be enemies next time we meet, Emiya."
...I hear her footsteps leaving.
Without seeing them off until the end...

page13.text:
"Now... No more playing around, boy."
The mage's finger strips away my consciousness.

page14.text:
...I'm in a deep darkness.
I don't know how many hours have passed.
I'm trying to keep track of the time by counting the seconds while I'm awake, but I can't think of any number beyond ten.
...Everything is hazy.
I don't feel my limbs, and it's calm as if I'm floating on water.
I can only imagine that my skull is filled with algae, and I feel like laughing in this darkness.
"..."
These days, Saber looks away every time I see her.
I think we obtained the Holy Grail quite some time ago.
Yet, Saber doesn't seem happy at all and keeps on apologizing to me.
"How are you doing, Shirou? We obtained the Holy Grail thanks to you, so tell me if there's anything you want. I can create anything for you, even if it is Saber or that girl."
...Something I want, something I want...
Nothing comes to mind. I never wanted anything, and even if I did, it won't do me any good now.
If anything, I want a colder place.
A painful darkness that would freeze the algae in my skull and make me want to dance.
"Long time no see, Emiya. I finally found you."
I hear a familiar voice.

page15.text: "Caster was right. You did that to let me escape. That's why I'm the only one that can look at you and laugh."

page16.text:
I try to raise my hand to greet her, but I can't.
I recall a specimen preserved in formalin.
I'm floating in water.
I can't feel my limbs.

page17.text:
"...I'll laugh it off for you.
The nightmare ends here, Shirou."

page18.text:
Oh, the water is pouring out.
My floating body starts rolling.
A warm darkness pours the algae out my skull and makes me want to laugh...
